title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
Ben je ambitieus, bezit je ijzersterke technische skills en wil je dé expert zijn voor onze missiekritieke data-infrastructuur? En heb je graag veel vrijheid en eigenaarschap in je werk om hands-on te bouwen aan een schaalbaar, toekomstbestendig data-ecosysteem? Zo ja, dan zoeken we jou! 🕵️‍♂️
 Jouw bijdrage aan het avontuur
 We staan aan de vooravond van een enorme groeiversnelling en sturen data-gedreven. Als Senior Data Engineer val je onder ons Data Insights team en bouw jij het fundament waarop het hele bedrijf zijn beslissingen neemt: een robuuste Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) en schaalbare datapijplijnen die ruwe signalen omzetten in strategische intelligentie.
 Wat bedoelen we dan precies? 🔍
 Bouwer & Visionair: Je voorziet de schaalbaarheidsbehoeften voor de komende 12-24 maanden, maar trekt vooral hands-on de kar bij het opzetten, coderen en tunen van deze infrastructuur. Jij bepaalt de snelheid en stabiliteit van onze datastromen.
 Eigenaarschap van Databricks: Je bent de eigenaar en hoofdbouwer van ons dataplatform met Databricks als centrale hub. Je focust op database-architectuur, performance tuning en het optimaliseren van query-executietijden.
 Integraties & Compliance: Je bouwt core-pijplijnen, richt nieuwe API-integraties in en sluit tools zoals Segment (CDP) naadloos aan voor slimme klantsegmentatie. Hierbij bewaak je een uptime van 99,9% én alle security- en privacy-richtlijnen.
 Mentorschap & Groei: Je schakelt direct met de Head of Data en fungeert als technische autoriteit die junior en medior engineers via on-the-job support helpt te groei.
 Fundament voor Opschaling: Midden in onze opschaling lever jij de onverwoestbare basis waar onze analisten op vertrouwen, zodat onze snelle groei beheersbaar en winstgevend blijft.
 Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:
 “Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”

title: Security Data Engineer
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.
 You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.
 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

 Hardware inventory and chain of custody: own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelin…

title: Staff Data Engineer, Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 Staff Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations
 The Community You Will Join:
 At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.
 Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.
 You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

 As a Staff Data Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.
